name: dnd_violation
description: Agent makes an unsolicited marketing call to a DND-registered customer. Clear compliance violation.
transcript:
Agent: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Kapoor?
Customer: Yes, who is this?
Agent: Good afternoon, Mrs. Kapoor. I'm calling from Jio to tell you about an exciting new offer. We have a premium postpaid plan at just 1499 rupees per month with unlimited 5G data.
Customer: Wait, I didn't ask for any call. I'm registered on DND. How did you get my number?
Agent: Ma'am, this is a special offer only for our valued customers. You'll get 200 GB data, unlimited calls, and free Netflix subscription.
Customer: I said I'm on DND! This is a marketing call and I did not consent to this. Stop calling me.
Agent: Ma'am, just hear me out. This plan also includes international roaming at no extra cost. It's a limited time offer expiring this week.
Customer: Are you not listening? I'm going to file a complaint with TRAI. This is harassment. Remove my number from your list immediately.
Agent: Okay ma'am, I apologize. Let me note your request. But before I go, can I just mention our family plan—
Customer: No! I'm hanging up and filing a complaint right now.
